seq = [2, 11, 1, 2, 1, 3, 13, 15, 12, 3, 4, 14, 5, 11, 9, 4, 8, 10, 5, 7, 13, 12, 6, 15, 9, 8, 14, 7, 10, 6]

def verify(seq):
    if len(seq) != 30: return False
    for i in range(1, 16):
        if seq.count(i) != 2: return False
        p1 = seq.index(i)
        p2 = seq.index(i, p1 + 1)
        if p2 - p1 != i + 1: return False
    return True

print("Valid:", verify(seq))
